/* Refinamiento visual de la invitación: misma papelería en todas las secciones */
#confirmar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f5eddf,#fbf7ef 48%,#f4ead9);color:#23382f;padding:88px 20px;border-top:1px solid #c5ad83;border-bottom:1px solid #c5ad83}

#confirmar .rsvp-option:has(input:checked){background:#e6e8dc;color:#23382f;border-color:#4c694f}
#confirmar .rsvp-option input{accent-color:#284c39}
#confirmar .note{color:#7b756b;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}
#confirmar .result{background:#e5e8dd;color:#23382f;border:1px solid #b9c6b4;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.6}
#adultos{background:#e9e8dc;color:#23382f;padding:85px 20px;border-top:1px solid #d6c4a5;border-bottom:1px solid #d6c4a5}
#adultos h2{font-size:clamp(45px,7vw,72px);color:#23382f}
#adultos .moon-icon{color:#a27b43;font-size:46px}
#adultos .adults-copy{color:#334a3b;font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,29px);max-width:740px}
#adultos .adults-closer{color:#8b704d;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.4px;max-width:620px;text-transform:uppercase}
.music-controls{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:20px;z-index:999;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px #24372b25)}

/* Animaciones sutiles de papelería, fotografías y detalles */
@keyframes envelopeFloat {0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
@keyframes inviteAppear {from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes coverOut {to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-15px) scale(.985)}}
@keyframes softShimmer {0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}
#cover .envelope-illustration{animation:envelopeFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite;transition:filter .35s ease}
#cover .envelope-illustration:hover,#cover .envelope-illustration:focus-visible{filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 16px #8b724d45)}
#cover .tag{animation:inviteAppear 1s ease both}
#cover .cover-name{animation:inviteAppear 1s .18s ease both}
#cover .sub{animation:inviteAppear 1s .3s ease both}
#cover .btn{animation:inviteAppear 1s .45s ease both}
#cover.cover-opening{animation:coverOut .58s ease-in forwards;pointer-events:none}
#invitation{animation:inviteAppear .8s ease both}
.motion-ready .motion-item{opacity:0;transform:translateY(19px);transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.2,1)}
.motion-ready .motion-item.motion-visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
#invitation .photo-pair img,#invitation .extra-photos img,#invitation .new-photo-gallery img{transition:transform 1s ease,box-shadow .7s ease;will-change:auto}
@media(hover:hover){#invitation .photo-pair img:hover,#invitation .extra-photos img:hover,#invitation .new-photo-gallery img:hover{transform:scale(1.018);box-shadow:0 16px 32px #4d3a2730}}
#vestimenta .color-tile,#vestimenta .avoid-swatch{transition:transform .45s ease,box-shadow .45s ease}
@media(hover:hover){#vestimenta .color-tile:hover,#vestimenta .avoid-swatch:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px #3d39241e}}
#regalos .ornament,#adultos .moon-icon{animation:softShimmer 5s ease-in-out infinite}
#invitation .btn,.music-toggle{transition:background-color .25s ease,transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
@media(hover:hover){#invitation .btn:hover,.music-toggle:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px #3c483422}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto!important}#cover *,#invitation *,#cover,#invitation{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;transform:none!important}.motion-ready .motion-item{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}}
